name: input-group
title: Input Group
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Input Group. The whole group is drawn like Input: a 2px ink line on paper; the inner input or textarea has no line of its own. Hover thickens the group's line (G3, fields); focus on the control thickens it to 3px with a paper gap and an ink ring around the group; aria-invalid on the control gives an accent line, a "!" mark and a serrated bottom edge; a disabled control gives a dashed line and a tone frame with the text on paper. Addons and InputGroupText read in ink in the reading face. InputGroupButton is a small kit button (2px frame, lettering, hover inverts to ink, pressed is a negative with a 2px offset, focus ring kept inside the group). Block addons (block-start / block-end) are separated by a fine ink rule. At least 44px tall under 640px. Exports inputGroupClassName for components whose input is an input group (Combobox).
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/input-group". It wraps your own components/ui/input-group, so Radix and Base UI both work. Put aria-invalid and disabled on the InputGroupInput / InputGroupTextarea: the group reads them.

meta.tagline: One ink line around a field and its addons, with a small lettered button inside.
meta.usage:
import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupButton, InputGroupInput, InputGroupText } from "@/components/ui/manga/input-group"

<InputGroup>
  <InputGroupAddon>
    <InputGroupText>https://</InputGroupText>
  </InputGroupAddon>
  <InputGroupInput placeholder="your-circle.example" />
  <InputGroupAddon align="inline-end">
    <InputGroupButton>Check</InputGroupButton>
  </InputGroupAddon>
</InputGroup>

props.name: align
props.description: On InputGroupAddon: where the addon sits. Block addons get a fine ink rule.

props.name: size
props.description: On InputGroupButton: the button size (a 44px touch target under 640px).

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: On InputGroupInput / InputGroupTextarea: the error look on the whole group.

props.name: inputGroupClassName
props.description: The group look, for a stock input group you do not render yourself.
